🚨 *GLOBAL POLICY TRIGGERS ALERT*
• *Source/Speaker:* US Senate \/ President Donald Trump \/ USTR
• *Announcement:* The US Senate has passed a bill granting the President the authority to impose tariffs of up to 100\% on Indian goods, primarily in response to India's continued purchases of Russian oil\. Indian suppliers are actively planning to diversify away from the US market in anticipation\.
• *Market Stance:* 🔴 BEARISH

📊 *CONFIDENCE LEVEL:* MEDIUM \(75\% \- The US Senate has passed legislation empowering the President to impose these tariffs, indicating a substantial and credible threat, though implementation is discretionary\.\)

🎯 *INDIAN MARKET IMPACT:*
• *Vulnerable Sectors:* Textiles, Apparel, Leather, Footwear, Plastic, Rubber, Organic Chemicals, Home Décor, Artisanal Products, certain Machinery\.
• *Strategic Tailwinds:* None
• *Expected FII Sentiment:* Net Outflows \(The significant threat of escalating tariffs, coupled with existing tariffs and active USTR investigations into Indian sectors, creates a high\-risk environment for export\-oriented businesses and discourages foreign investment in Indian equities\.\)

💡 *TACTICAL ACTIONABLE OUTCOME:* Fund managers should urgently reassess exposure to export\-reliant Indian sectors, particularly those listed for potential tariffs, and consider diversifying portfolios towards domestic consumption themes or sectors less exposed to US trade policy shifts\.
